title: Solutions
description: Production-ready DEEPCRAFT™ Ready Models and edge AI software solutions from Infineon — the fastest way to production in the Hub.
long_description: The Solutions section features fully developed models and applications you can download, evaluate on supported hardware, and integrate into your product—without training a model from scratch. Solutions skip the full model development cycle and give you field-proven models already optimized for Infineon MCUs. Each solution includes metadata for sensors, target devices, compatible kits, application domains, and performance metrics (memory usage, inference time, and power where available). Solutions are maintained by Infineon and are not open for community contribution.
